reason: Claude2DSH is a migration and synchronization integration that converts Claude Code sessions and related assets into DSH-native data and can export or mirror DSH sessions back to Claude Code JSONL copies.

summaries.zh: Claude2DSH 在 Claude Code 与 DeepSeek Harness 之间迁移、导出和同步会话、技能及相关上下文资产。
summaries.en: Claude2DSH migrates, exports, and synchronizes Claude Code sessions, skills, and related context assets with DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Reads Claude Code conversation and configuration files from local directories
Imports sessions, skills, global context, project memory, and plugin asset metadata into DSH
Exports DSH sessions as Claude Code JSONL copies
Synchronizes and merges session data between DSH and Claude Code copies
Monitors for new turns for optional automatic mirroring
Writes migrated data and safe copies under DSH-managed paths
